sewing: I am certain that a Sewing Machine would relieve as much human suffering as a hundred Lunatic Asylums, and possibly a good deal more.
sewers:
In view of the fading animals
the proliferation of sewers and fears
the sea clogging, the air
nearing extinction we should be kind, we should
take warning, we should forgive each other Instead we are opposite, we
touch as though attacking, the gifts we bring
even in good faith maybe
warp in our hands to
implements, to manoeuvres
